Your field kit

Field notebook

A case you can carry

Choose a familiar public walk with trees. Listen to a short chapter, pocket your phone, and look for the clue. The story is fictional. Your observations are real.

Download the field kit before you leave. It includes the case, notes, and any prepared audio. Open it in a browser that supports local HTML files. Download your journal when you return.

The hosted walkthrough uses player review. Local Gemma review runs through the companion service on your computer; it is never silently replaced with a pretend AI result. ElevenLabs narration and Sentry tracing are optional connections.

Photos stay in this browser unless you send them to your local companion. Tracing excludes photos and note content. Private browsing or clearing browser data can remove your notebook.
